deployment: one logical prefill instance over 910b-16/28; one logical decode instance over 910b-17/27

pd_metrics.llm_pd_running_requests: gauge, logical actual requests before graph padding, not device utilization
pd_metrics.llm_pd_mamba_slots: gauge with state used/available/evictable/total; slots, not tokens
pd_metrics.llm_pd_requests_total: counter with event received/kv_delivered/completed/failed/cancelled; success and cancellation separate
pd_metrics.llm_pd_prefix_tokens_total: counter; prefill source hbm/host/ssd/unattributed/miss; decode source local_reuse/transferred, independent of carried P cache
pd_metrics.llm_pd_running_context_tokens: gauge, input plus generated tokens of actual running logical requests
pd_metrics.llm_pd_spec_tokens_total: counter with kind accepted/proposed/emitted; accepted counts accepted drafts only
pd_metrics.llm_pd_spec_verify_total: counter, request verify calls; acceptance length includes bonus separately
pd_metrics.llm_pd_concurrency_seconds_total: counter with requests integer label, time residence by actual logical concurrency
pd_metrics.llm_pd_snapshot_age_seconds: gauge per dp_rank; staleness is not zero load
pd_metrics.llm_pd_last_snapshot_monotonic_seconds: native gauge; exporter computes snapshot age using the same host's monotonic clock
pd_metrics.llm_pd_instrumentation_errors_total: counter by operation; absent before the first error, never an inference exception
pd_metrics.llm_pd_expected_local_dp_ranks: gauge per node, no dp_rank; sum gives P2/D8 expected coverage
pd_metrics.llm_pd_metric_available: gauge with metric_group label; unknown is not zero
pd_metrics.llm_pd_build_info: info gauge, bounded deployment topology/version/config labels

gateway_metrics.llm_gateway_inflight_requests: gauge, held for full downstream response stream lifetime
gateway_metrics.llm_gateway_ttft_seconds: request-weighted histogram, first_event semantic/visible; semantic includes reasoning/text/tool argument deltas; visible excludes reasoning
gateway_metrics.llm_gateway_request_tpot_seconds: request-weighted histogram, real first/last semantic output timestamps divided by known final completion_tokens minus one; no token/chunk-count inference
gateway_metrics.llm_gateway_prompt_tokens_total: counter based only on known final usage
gateway_metrics.llm_gateway_output_tokens_total: counter based only on known final usage
gateway_metrics.llm_gateway_usage_missing_total: counter, no fabricated TPOT when usage unknown

notes: Implemented and validated on the two-host P / two-host D reference deployment on 2026-10-27; see monitoring/docs/validation.md for limits.
Gateway times are observed at the gateway, not full client network latency.
Each attention DP leader publishes once; never sum identical TP/EP copies.
Missing telemetry must remain unavailable and must not be zero-filled.
